title: fix(lint)!: refuse an action body whose regular-expression literal never closes or carries a bad flag set
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuN4HJwYpEVN4miNNeg3Dyvp)_
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTggz8AL2bCABoDGis

Fixes #35040

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the action-body compile check or regular-expression literals in an action body (`git grep` over `skills/` at df02e1ce: 0 hits for `does-not-compile`, 0 relevant hits for regular expressions)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:动作脚本体里写坏的正则字面量(没闭合的 `/abc`、非法 flag 如 `/a/gg`)现在在保存/校验时直接报错拒收,而不是只给警告。
- **为什么改**:这类脚本体运行时的 QuickJS 同样编译不过,之前保存成功、每次运行都 500;只有正则"模式内部"的差异(两个引擎确实不一致的地方)仍保留为警告。
- **风险与回滚**:收窄接受集(BREAKING,仅影响本来就从未跑通过的动作体);首方示例零命中;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`(`REGEXP_PATTERN_FAILURE` 一行决定警告/拒收分界)、同目录测试文件末尾新 describe、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts`,预期 25 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`action-body-does-not-compile` sent every host `SyntaxError` whose sentence opens `Invalid regular expression` to `warning`. V8's two **token** errors open the same way: an unterminated literal (`Invalid regular expression: missing /`) and an invalid flag set (`Invalid regular expression flags`). QuickJS refuses both, so a body carrying one was accepted at write and failed every run with the coded 500.

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`: the warning arm is now positively identified by V8's **pattern-body** shape only (`Invalid regular expression: /PATTERN/FLAGS: REASON`, anchored on the colon-space-slash). Every other sentence — the two token errors included, and any future one — is `error`. The two token errors get their own hint (close the literal / escape a slash / give a division its left operand; flags from `dgimsuvy`, each once, never `u` with `v`). The module docblock and the `severity` field doc now state the measured split.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (comment), `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`: the "a regular-expression literal the host refuses is a warning" sentence would be false after this change; each now says only a pattern is a warning.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused.ts`: new ADR-0087 semantic entry for the narrowing.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-does-not-compile-refused.ts`: amended, two phrases. The entry shipped in 18.6.0 (`content/docs/releases/v18/18-6.mdx` row and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`), but the registry is what `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide project at HEAD; left as it was, an upgrader reading 18.7 would get "never refused" beside the new entry's "refused". The amendment keeps the 18.6 meaning for patterns and points to the new entry for tokens. The released CHANGELOG and release page are untouched.
- `.changeset/35040-action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, `registered action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused`.

Sibling #34987 (hook and job bodies, same file) is out of scope and untouched.

### QuickJS probe (the measurement the split follows)

Host: node 22.23.5, V8 12.4.254.21-node.57, `vm.Script`. Runtime: `quickjs-emscripten` 0.32.0 (`newQuickJSWASMModule`, release-sync variant — the one `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` uses), `evalCode` of the same wrapper `(async (input, ctx) => { SOURCE })`, which compiles and does not call.

| case | body | V8 | QuickJS |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| unterminated literal | `return /abc;` | `Invalid regular expression: missing /` | refuses: `unexpected end of regexp` |
| unterminated, open class | `return /[/;` | `missing /` | refuses: `unexpected end of regexp` |
| body ends inside a literal | `return /abc` | `missing /` | refuses: `unexpected end of regexp` |
| trailing backslash | `return /abc` + backslash | `missing /` | refuses: `unexpected end of regexp` |
| broken by a newline | `return /ab` NL `c/;` | `missing /` | refuses: `unexpected line terminator in regexp` |
| repeated flag | `return /a/gg;` | `Invalid regular expression flags` | refuses: `invalid regular expression flags` |
| unknown flag | `return /a/zz;` | `flags` | refuses: same |
| unknown flag | `return /a/q;` | `flags` | refuses: same |
| `u` with `v` | `return /a/uv;` | `flags` | refuses: same |
| escaped flag | `/a/` + backslash-u0067 | `flags` | refuses: `expecting ';'` |
| flag `v` | `return /[a&&b]/v;` | compiles | compiles |
| flag `d`, `gimsuy` | `/a/d`, `/a/gimsuy` | compiles | compiles |
| unterminated group | `return /(/;` | pattern: `Unterminated group` | refuses: `expecting ')'` |
| duplicate named group (two groups both named `a`) | — | pattern: `Duplicate capture group name` | **compiles** |
| modifier group | `return /(?i:a)/;` | pattern: `Invalid group` | **compiles** |
| nothing to repeat | `return /a**/;` | pattern | refuses |
| class range out of order | `return /[b-a]/;` | pattern | refuses |
| named back-reference to no group (`u`) | — | pattern | refuses |
| unknown unicode property (`u`) | `/\p{Nope}/u` | pattern | refuses |
| incomplete quantifier (`u`) | `/a{/u` | pattern | refuses |
| positive lookbehind on `a` before `b` | — | compiles | compiles |
| controls | valid literal; `const input = 1` | compiles; redeclaration | compiles; `invalid redefinition of parameter name` |

Flag sweep: 55 single characters (`a-z`, `A-Z`, `$`, `_`, `0`) plus all 64 ordered pairs of `dgimsuvy` = 119 flag sets, V8 and QuickJS agree on accept/refuse for **119/119**; no flag set V8 refuses is accepted by QuickJS.

Reading: the hypothesis holds. Both token classes are refused by QuickJS in every probed case, so they go to `error`. The dialect gap lives in the pattern body — and it is **two** places, not the one the module docblock named: modifier groups are a second pattern V8 (Node 22) refuses and QuickJS runs. Pattern-body failures stay `warning`; some of them (unterminated group, nothing to repeat, …) are refused by QuickJS too, which this PR leaves at warning (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts` (the rule's existing harness file):

- four unterminated-literal shapes → `[rule, severity, path]` = `['action-body-does-not-compile', 'error', 'actions[0].body.source']`;
- three invalid flag sets → `error`;
- duplicate named group and modifier group → still `warning`;
- `/a/dgimsuy` and a `v`-flag class compile clean;
- the doors: `os validate` refuses `return /abc;` at error, and the runtime publish gate puts it in `errors`, none in `advisories`.

Assertions are rule id + severity (+ path), no message or hint text pinned.

<details><summary>Results (head df02e1ce)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts` — Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 25 passed (25).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` — Test Files 220 passed (220), Tests 9288 passed / 5 skipped (9293); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` — tsc clean, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated` — "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"; `vitest run src/migrations` — Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 198 passed (198).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` — 3 passed (3).
- Dogfood battery, once on head df02e1ce (closure built first, under the verify lock): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` — VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 482 passed / 3 skipped (485), Tests 4092 passed / 68 skipped (4160), no failures.
- First-party exposure: `validateActionBodyCompiles` over every action exported by `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/**` (the only example tree carrying `language: 'js'` action bodies) — 0 findings.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot; no permanent file)</summary>

Committed the fix first, then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` restored the old classifier (`REGEXP_PATTERN_FAILURE` back to the unanchored `^SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression`) — anchor 1 → 0, blob bae57fbc → 1fb048a7. The test file went red: **8 failed / 17 passed (25)** — exactly the four unterminated, three flag and one door pins; the two warning-preservation pins stayed green as they should. Restore: blob after restore = HEAD blob bae57fbc, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the rule from `src/` (relative import), so no `dist/` leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Pattern-body failures QuickJS also refuses (unterminated group, nothing to repeat, out-of-order class range, unknown property, incomplete quantifier, dangling named back-reference) stay at `warning` — the card's Done-when covers the token classes only. Promoting them means an allow-list of V8 pattern reasons, which a future V8 can widen under us; left as a note, not filed. carrier: none.
- The module docblock said the engines "disagreed in one place" (duplicate named groups); the probe found a second (modifier groups). Corrected in this PR's docblock, rule explanation and docs page.
- **Duplicate Fix Guard:** the head branch is `claude/project-thread-iswnar`, not `claude/issue-35040-…` — platform exception: this card thread can push only its assigned branch (claim comment 7001374222).
- The claim's line reads `Clause-②: no` with no arm; this PR and the changeset declare `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, because the level gate refuses `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` beside a line with no `(narrowing)` arm (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) and the change does narrow the accepted set. The title carries `!` for the same reason: AGENTS.md names a `(narrowing)` arm BREAKING.

## Verification

Local subset: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; change set from merge base 3819afec, tree df02e1ce) derived 115 families; all 115 run, reconciled with `--ran`: "115 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 115 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `overlap-check.mjs` before each push: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. Every CI family is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

All 115 derived commands exited 0. Five first exited 3/1 as unmet prerequisites (nothing measured), and passed on a re-run after the prerequisite was met:

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` — exit 3 on the shallow clone (pinned positive-control commit unreachable); after fetching that one commit into a private ref, exit 0, 48 cases.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` — exit 1 at oclif manifest load (cli not built); after `@objectstack/cli...` build, exit 0, 3/3.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` — exit 3 (client-react dist missing); after build, exit 0, "345 prose examples type-check".
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit 3 (dists missing); after the full packages build, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` — exit 3 (lock queue timeout while the dogfood run held it); run under the lock, exit 0, "0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number".

Local-only family `check:dev-prereqs` (not derived): exit 1, "35 of 108 workspace packages declare an entry point under dist/ that is not on disk" — all under `ui/`, which this box never built; a reading of this container, not of the diff.

</details>

**Main merge before opening (head bf5fc6514, origin/main e91d9671):** merged cleanly; main changed one file in this diff's set (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, no conflict).
